title: Český Krumlov Castle
visualBrief: Individual ridge castle: open double-courtyard upper palace, lower Hradek and54.5m decorated round tower with a real open arcade, flared copper roofs/lantern, mapped service ranges, western theater/elevated gallery and stacked arched Cloak Bridge. Shared pale plaster, salmon accents and red ceramic roofs.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained exact-QID enclosure, selected current PMTiles component polygons with courtyard holes and named Cloak Bridge path. Nearby town buildings and overlapping building-part overlays are excluded.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Mapped overall54.5m tower,23m upper palace,11m theater and5–14m selected ranges retained. Untagged heights, court levels, arch/roof/window profiles and bridge stories are picture-led estimates.

bridges.scope: Named mapped crossing controls the bridge axis; short theater-end continuation and all story/arch profiles are photo-led estimates.

reconstruction.heightBasis: Retain mapped overall heights of54.5m tower,23m upper palace,11m theater and5–14m selected ranges. Untagged ranges use conservative exterior estimates. Court/bridge attachment levels are approximate against standard DEM and the pictures.
reconstruction.scope: Upper palace with both open courtyards, decorated lower tower and Hradek courtyard, selected castle service ranges, theater, western elevated gallery and stacked Cloak Bridge. Village, gardens, site trees, detailed interiors and painted fresco imagery excluded.

geographicProposal.reviewStatus: Reviewed approximate exterior fit against two inspected photographs and retained standard viewer PMTiles/DEM; survey precision and navigable collision are excluded.

terrainReference.basis: NativeY0 equals retained standard viewer DEM497.6021m at the anchor. Upper/lower/theater courts and bridge attachment levels are photo-led exterior estimates; coarse DEM is not a bare-earth survey.

geographicProposal.notes: Exact-QID compound plus current component plans, courtyard holes, tower height and named bridge fix approximate scale/facing. Court heights, roof/arch profiles, foundations and precise bridge joins remain estimates.

scaleBasis: Actual selected plans and signed tower/theater locations establish approximate compound scale and facing; all courtyard holes remain open.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.

dataAttribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors; Protomaps; Mapzen/USGS terrain tiles.
materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.
reviewStatus: source-geometry; near/far and shared-material captures pending
limitations: Selected current PMTiles polygons guide approximate compound fit; overlapping building-part overlays and nearby town polygons are excluded. Heights with tags are retained; untagged ranges and facade/window/roof profiles are exterior estimates.

Standard viewer DEM supplies a working497.6021m anchor datum. Upper/lower/theater court levels, foundations and bridge story/arch/approach joins are estimates; no bare-earth survey, terrain carving or navigable collision guarantee.

Tower decoration uses a sparse shared-material/palette rhythm rather than exact painted frescoes. Gallery arches are real openings; detailed stairs, rooms, museum exhibits, gardens, trees and neighboring village are excluded.

The western elevated gallery is mapped outside the main enclosure; its support and roof profile are approximate. Cloak Bridge path fixes its axis; theater-end continuation and stacked corridors are photo-led.
Physical laptop and phone frame-rate measurements remain pending.
importReason: Preserve decorated tower/open gallery, connected red-roofed courtyard palace and stacked Cloak Bridge in independently authored browser levels.
